outcome: Severe maternal morbidity (SMM) during delivery-related hospitalization
cohort: 11,628,438 hospital discharges in the United States from January 2008 to December 2021 with any delivery diagnosis or procedure code
finding: Delivery-related mortality in US hospitals decreased for all subgroups from 2008 to 2021, while SMM prevalence increased for all patients, with higher rates for racial and ethnic minority patients of any age.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher odds of both mortality and SMM.
